chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti narrated from al-Ridha عليه السلام that he said:
A man may give the adhan while sitting, and he may give the adhan while riding.

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: a man, referring here to the person giving the call
key_terms.يُؤَذِّنُ: gives the adhan, meaning calls people to prayer

ai.seo_question: Can a person give the adhan while sitting or riding?
ai.summary: This hadith states that giving the adhan is valid even when a person is sitting or riding. It indicates flexibility in the manner of delivering the call to prayer and relates to practical rulings of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.867 - Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti narrated from Imam al-Ridha (as) that He said:
"A man may give the adhan (call to prayer) while sitting or while riding."
